concerns.text: Task T003 claims to fulfill **FR‑030**, but FR‑030 is not defined anywhere in the specification. Introducing a synthetic‑dataset generator for an undefined requirement constitutes gold‑plating and violates the Constitution’s prohibition on adding un‑specified functional requirements.

Task T090 performs a domain‑bias assessment and references an undefined success criterion “SC‑???”, as well as FR‑027/FR‑032 which are absent from the spec. Adding this bias‑assessment work and undefined criteria expands the project scope beyond the approved requirements, breaching the Constitution’s single‑source‑of‑truth and non‑gold‑plating principles.

The dependencies table lists **SC‑030 (synthetic precision/recall)**, yet SC‑030 does not exist in the specification. Referencing a non‑existent success criterion creates an orphan requirement and weakens the traceability of acceptance criteria.
